_label: SYNTHETIC. Kafin LGA planning assumptions (docs/SCENARIO.md), not real data. Stock, use and roads come from Zetaris; this file holds only what Zetaris does not.
donor_keep_extra_days_note: A donor also keeps the State CMS (S1) resupply lead time, 4 weeks, so a transfer never leaves it short before free stock can arrive.
road_risk_target_days_note: A clinic whose road is forecast to close inside the horizon is stocked for 60 days, not 28, because it cannot be resupplied while the road is shut.

S1.name: State CMS (govt)
S1.note: free stock, allocated by the state, not orderable on demand
